blocks.text: TALISAY CITY, Cebu — Personnel from the City of Talisay – Traffic Operation Development Authority (CT-TODA) rescued a two-year-old boy after becoming accidentally trapped inside a locked vehicle for nearly 10 minutes on Friday afternoon, November 20, 2026. The incident occurred after 2:00 p.m. in the basement parking area of a commercial establishment in Barangay Tabunok.
